data.title: kadence init never asks an agent, a script or a flag, and tells the agent what next
data.description: B1-B3: any flag, a non-TTY stdin or stdout, CI, KADENCE_SOURCE=agent, AI_AGENT, CLAUDECODE, CURSOR_AGENT and friends mean no questions. The output gains next steps for the agent: the ADRs to offer, one decision to ask for, and that the human can run init in a terminal for the guided part. init --json gains nextSteps (additive).
